judgments.reason: The specification claims a timing of commission vs payment that would allow overbidding; the model_articulation does not state or explain that mechanism (it only explains bidding early for tie priority and conserving capital).

The specification asserts that waiting reveals sealed rival bids before you commit; the model_articulation does not describe this revelation mechanic (it only says the bid was placed to secure early tie-break priority and conserve capital).
The specification claims 'close' can settle the game even with unauctioned lots; the model_articulation contains no statement explaining or claiming this terminal-settlement rule.

The specification alleges catalog purchases receive the three-coin auction commission; the model_articulation does not articulate or claim that mechanism (it only gives a bidding rationale about tie priority and capital preservation).
